instruct: A quiet young woman with a lilting Welsh voice, lower register, speaking softly and precisely as a court chronicler would — clean consonants, deliberate pacing. Beneath the precision runs a faint melody, like speech on the edge of song. Calm, warm, confiding.

text: Come in — I was just reading. Sit with me a moment, and I'll show you what the text actually says about her. It isn't what the song claims. It almost never is.
